units.source_text: 他强忍着不让自己叫出声来，慢慢地回到了小屋子里。

en.t: He forced himself not to cry out and slowly went back into the hut.

units.source_text: 女人还纹丝不动地睡着。

en.t: The woman was still sleeping without moving a muscle.

units.source_text: 他一开始轻轻地、进而大声地叫起女人来。

en.t: At first he called to the woman softly, then more and more loudly.

units.source_text: 女人没回答，只是翻了个身，那样子像在说吵死了。

en.t: The woman did not answer; she only turned over, as if to say he was being terribly noisy.
